coverage.sampleMethod: native-aligned 10-pixel center grid, WTR excluded for land fraction
coverage.unsupported: Reference: farther than 500 native px from city controls or failed inverse. Broad illumination: outside lon +/-180, lat [-60,85], failed inverse or fold. Polar and remote domains remain approximate or unsupported.

interpretation: Approximate modern-reference alignment to native province anchors; not a surveyed CRS.

inverseGrid.invalid: NaN; inverseConfidence=0; never interpolate across invalid samples
inverseGrid.model: smoothRegistration; reference 500px nearest-control domain; broad variant only for solar shading

confidencePolicy.180: smooth modern reference within 500 native px of a control
confidencePolicy.255: inside control hull and within 200 native px of a control
confidencePolicy.96: broad solar approximation only; modern point/line layers excluded

confirmation.split: sorted accepted city ids: every fifth at offset one held out

smoothRegistration.inverseMethod: seed plus four Newton iterations; forward residual <=0.25 native pixels
smoothRegistration.limitation: City anchors and smooth extrapolation are approximate; no local surveyed accuracy claim outside controls.

trianglesPurpose: Strict shared-triangle diagnostic baseline; active forward mapping is smoothRegistration.
unsupportedPolicy: Modern reference uses the smooth inverse within 500 native pixels of city controls. Broad solar approximation permits bounded smooth continuation over lon [-180,180], lat [-60,85]. Invalid inverse solutions and local folds are excluded; confidence distinguishes these domains.

validation.split: sort native place id; every fifth city held out before fitting
